function @_Cede_pid1($_setpoint:number, $_processvalue:number, $_kp:number, $_ki:number, $_kd:number, $_min:number, $_max:number, $_integral:number, $_prev_error:number) : number
	var $_error = $_setpoint - $_processvalue
	var $_dt = delta_time
	var $_derivative = ($_error - $_prev_error) / $_dt
	var $_proportional = $_kp * $_error
	$_integral += $_error * $_dt
	if $_integral < $_min
		$_integral = $_min
	if $_integral > $_max
		$_integral = $_max
	$_prev_error = $_error
	var $_output = $_proportional + $_ki * $_integral + $_kd * $_derivative
	if $_output < $_min
		$_output = $_min
	if $_output > $_max
		$_output = $_max

var $screen = screen(10,0);
var $disp = 1
var $lightsettings = 0
	
update	


			
	$screen.blank(color(0,0,0,0));
	$screen.write(2,1,red,"disp")
	if $screen.button_rect(0,0, 27, 10, color(200,0,0,255))
		if $lightsettings
			$disp = 1
			$lightsettings = 0
		else
			$disp = !$disp
		
		

	if $light.on
		$screen.write(29,1,yellow,"Light")
		if $screen.button_rect(28,0, 60, 10, color(200,200,0,255))
			$lightsettings = !$lightsettings
	else
		$screen.write(29,1,color(60,60,0,255),"light")
		if $screen.button_rect(28,0, 60, 10, color(60,0,0,255))
			$lightsettings = !$lightsettings
		
	;settings for the light.	
	if $lightsettings
		if($light.on)
			$screen.write(29,11,green,"on")
		if(!$light.on)
			$screen.write(29,11,red,"off")
		if $screen.button_rect(27,10,46, 20, color(200,0,0,255))
			$light.on = !$light.on
			
		$screen.write(129,11,red,"normal")
		if $screen.button_rect(127,10,166, 20, color(200,200,0,255))
			$light.red = 255
			$light.green = 255
			$light.blue = 255
			
		$screen.write(129,31,red,"turbo")
		if $screen.button_rect(127,30,166, 50, color(200,200,255,255))
			$light.red = 2550000
			$light.green = 2550000
			$light.blue = 2550000
			
		$screen.write(129,61,red,"mega")
		if $screen.button_rect(127,60,166, 80, color(200,200,255,255))
			$light.red = 2500500000
			$light.green = 2550000000
			$light.blue = 2550000000
		$screen.write(59,0,blue,text("current color: {},{},{}",$light.red,$light.green,$light.blue))
		
		$screen.write(169,61,red,"VECTOR")
		if $screen.button_rect(167,60,196, 80, color(0,255,0,255))
			$light.red = -2500050000000
			$light.green = 2550000000000000
			$light.blue = -25005000000
	
		return
	
	if !$disp
		return
	
	;Display heading and lat/lon.
	var $lon = input_number(4,9)
	var $lat = input_number(4,8)	
	$screen.write(151,0,blue,text("dst:{} ", round($heading*10)/10))
	$screen.write(0,10,blue,text("lat:{}", round($lat*100)/100))
	$screen.write(0,20,blue,text("lon:{}", round($lon*100)/100))
	
	$screen.write(151,10,green,"+")
	$screen.write(151,20,Red,"-")
	if $screen.button_rect(150, 10, 157, 17, color(200,100,0,250))
		$spd += 5
	if $screen.button_rect(150, 20, 157, 27, color(200,100,0,250))
		$spd -= 5
	
	$screen.write(130,10,green,"max")
	$screen.write(130,20,Red,"min")
	if $screen.button_rect(130-1, 10-1, 149, 18, color(200,100,0,250))
		$spd = 100
	if $screen.button_rect(130-1, 20-1, 149, 28, color(200,100,0,250))
		$spd = 1

	$spd = clamp($spd,1,100)
	var $thrustcolor = color(200,100,0,250)

	var $autocolor = red
	if($auto)
		$autocolor = green
		$screen.write(20,45,color(0,200,0,255),"Auto pilot engaged")
		$thrustcolor = color(200,100,0,255)
	else
		$screen.write(20,45,color(200,100,0,220),"Auto pilot off")
	$screen.write(85,00,$thrustcolor,text("thrust:{}%", round($spd*100)/100))

	$screen.write(40,30,$autocolor,"Auto")
	if $screen.button_rect(40-1, 30-1, 64, 38, color(255,255,0,255))
		$auto = !$auto
